en: The image shows the interior of a church with a prominent altar at the center. The architecture features rounded arches with alternating light and dark voussoirs, reminiscent of Moorish or Romanesque style. The altar is adorned with a crucifix, candles, flowers, and a cloth with Christian motifs. Wall paintings or frescoes depict religious scenes and groups of people, including nuns. There are plaques or inscriptions on either side of the altar, but the text is not fully legible. The overall feel is solemn and historical, with wooden pews in the foreground.
